svg.text: Video Security System — Capture & Detection Architecture
as fast as NVR can serve
NVR cameras only — no RTSP overlap
Detection Logic (nvr_detectd & cam_detectd — independent per camera)
annotated captures • fast writes • minimal I/O
images > 10 s old → moved to HDD
blocks idle — zero I/O when quiet
HDD fallback if client polls slow
all requests arrive as local LAN
no cloud relay — local LAN only
⟵ WireGuard VPN Tunnel — Persistent • Keepalive Enabled • Fully Localized • No Cloud ⟶
All connections arrive as local LAN traffic via WireGuard virtual interface — server has no awareness of remote
Tunnel survives phone idle / NAT expiry
All traffic on-premises • no cloud relay
Encrypted • Low latency • No public exposure
